name: Jotform
description: Jotform is a no-code online form builder for collecting submissions, payments, signatures, registrations, and operational data through customizable forms and workflows.
best_for: Businesses that need flexible no-code forms for operations, registrations, payments, approvals, signatures, and data collection.
features: Embeds, custom styling, notifications, and workflow automation

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Free plan with 5 forms, 100 monthly submissions, 100 MB storage, 10 monthly payment submissions, and Jotform branding on the current pricing page.

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.notes: Price shown as $34/month when billed annually. Includes 25 forms, 1,000 monthly submissions, 1 GB storage, and no Jotform branding.

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.notes: Price shown as $39/month when billed annually. Includes 50 forms, 2,500 monthly submissions, 10 GB storage, and no Jotform branding.

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.notes: Price shown as $99/month when billed annually. Includes 100 forms, 10,000 monthly submissions, 100 GB storage, and HIPAA-enabled features.

pros: Starter plan includes core form-building features at no cost for low-volume use
Large template and integration ecosystem with conditional logic and payment collection
Paid tiers scale form count, submission volume, storage, payment submissions, and branding controls
cons: The free plan is capped at five forms and 100 monthly submissions
Published paid-plan prices depend on annual billing for the lowest displayed monthly rates
HIPAA-enabled features are reserved for the Gold tier on the current public pricing table

faq.question: Does Jotform have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Jotform's Starter plan is free and currently includes five forms and up to 100 monthly submissions, with usage and branding limits.

faq.question: How much does Jotform Bronze cost?
faq.answer: Jotform's current pricing page shows Bronze at $34 per month when billed annually.

faq.question: Can Jotform collect payments?
faq.answer: Yes. Jotform supports payment collection through forms. The free Starter tier includes a limited number of monthly payment submissions, with higher limits on paid plans.
